integrity.claim_support: The upper half-plane distance identity, independent exponential-height decomposition, triangular mixing density, exact quadratic threshold, and uniform asymptotic inversion are established in RESULT.md.
integrity.independence_statement: No independent scientific audit or external mathematical certification is claimed.
integrity.supplementary_computation: A standalone standard-library checker uses a distinct upper-half-plane sampling formula and Simpson quadrature; finite random checks are not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Exact tail quadrature is stated only for R >= 2 arsinh(w/4); small-radius distribution is not claimed.
Distances are intrinsic to the truncated cusp with boundary, not ambient distances on an unspecified complete hyperbolic surface.
Asymptotic estimates hold for each fixed w, without a uniform large-width claim.
Historical priority and independent external mathematical verification remain unestablished.
title: Sharp random-distance tails and inverse rigidity for finite-area hyperbolic cusps
